source.text: וְהַנַּ֧עַר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל מְשָׁרֵ֥ת אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י עֵלִ֑י וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֤ה יָקָר֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין חָז֖וֹן נִפְרָֽץ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the boy Samuel [was] serving Yahweh before Eli; and [the] word of Yahweh was rare in the days those; there [was] not vision spreading out.

en.L: And the boy Samuel was serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} before Eli. And the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was rare in those days; there was no vision breaking out.
en.B: The boy Samuel was serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} under Eli. The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was rare in those days, and visions were few.
en.R: The boy Samuel served {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and Eli was in charge of him. In those days {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} seldom gave anyone a message, and people seldom saw visions from God.

es.L: Y el niño Samuel servía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} delante de Elí. Y la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} era escasa en aquellos días; no había visión que se difundiera.
es.B: El niño Samuel servía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} bajo la dirección de Elí. En aquellos días la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} era escasa, y las visiones eran pocas.
es.R: El niño Samuel servía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y Elí estaba a cargo de él. En aquellos días {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} casi nunca daba un mensaje a nadie, y la gente casi nunca tenía visiones de parte de Dios.

fr.L: Et le jeune Samuel servait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} devant Éli. Et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} était rare en ces jours-là ; il n’y avait pas de vision qui se répandait.
fr.B: Le jeune Samuel servait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sous la conduite d’Éli. La parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} était rare en ce temps-là, et les visions n’étaient pas fréquentes.
fr.R: Le jeune Samuel servait {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et Éli s’occupait de lui. À cette époque, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnait rarement un message à quelqu’un, et les gens voyaient rarement des visions venant de Dieu.

vi.L: Cậu bé Sa-mu-ên phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trước mặt Hê-li. Trong những ngày ấy, lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hiếm hoi; không có khải tượng nào lan ra.
vi.B: Cậu bé Sa-mu-ên phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dưới sự hướng dẫn của Hê-li. Thời ấy lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất hiếm, khải tượng cũng ít.
vi.R: Cậu bé Sa-mu-ên phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và Hê-li là người coi sóc cậu. Thời ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ít khi ban sứ điệp cho ai, và người ta ít khi thấy khải tượng từ Đức Chúa Trời.

decisions.choice: the boy: a youth, not yet a grown man
decisions.reason: The word is used for anyone from a small child to a young man. Samuel was brought to Shiloh as a little child (1:24), and some years have passed since then (2:21, 26). The text does not give his age.

decisions.choice: serving Yahweh before Eli: helping in the sanctuary under Eli's oversight
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for priestly service at the sanctuary (2:11, 18). "Before Eli" means in Eli's presence and under his direction: Samuel serves Yahweh, and Eli is the priest in charge.

decisions.choice: rare: scarce, and so precious
decisions.reason: The word describes something costly because it is hard to find. Yahweh was speaking seldom. The chapter ends with the opposite: Yahweh revealing himself again and again at Shiloh (verse 21).

decisions.choice: there was no vision breaking out: visions were not frequent
decisions.reason: The verb means "break through" or "spread out". The phrase says that visions from Yahweh were not breaking through to his people, or were not spreading among them. Either way the point is the same: God was seldom heard from.

decisions.choice: under Eli; Eli was in charge of him; visions from God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what "before Eli" means. Readable adds "from God" to show what kind of visions are meant.

source.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְעֵלִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ב בִּמְקֹמ֑וֹוְעֵינָיו֙ הֵחֵ֣לּוּ כֵה֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was on the day the that, and Eli [was] lying in his place, and his eyes began [to be] dim; not he was able to see,

en.L: And it happened on that day, when Eli was lying down in his place, and his eyes had begun [to be] dim; he was not able to see,
en.B: At that time Eli, whose sight had begun to fail so that he could not see, was lying down in his usual place,
en.R: One night Eli was lying down in his usual place. His eyes were getting weak, and he could not see.

es.L: Y sucedió en aquel día, cuando Elí estaba acostado en su lugar, y sus ojos habían comenzado [a] oscurecerse; no podía ver,
es.B: Por aquel tiempo, Elí, cuya vista había empezado a debilitarse hasta el punto de no poder ver, estaba acostado en su lugar de costumbre,
es.R: Una noche, Elí estaba acostado en su lugar de siempre. Sus ojos se estaban debilitando, y ya no podía ver.

fr.L: Et il arriva en ce jour-là, alors qu’Éli était couché à sa place, et ses yeux avaient commencé à faiblir ; il ne pouvait pas voir,
fr.B: En ce temps-là, Éli, dont la vue avait commencé à baisser au point qu’il ne voyait plus, était couché à sa place habituelle,
fr.R: Une nuit, Éli était couché à sa place habituelle. Ses yeux devenaient faibles, et il ne voyait plus.

vi.L: Vào ngày ấy, khi Hê-li đang nằm ở chỗ mình, mắt ông đã bắt đầu lờ mờ; ông không thể nhìn thấy,
vi.B: Lúc ấy Hê-li, mắt đã bắt đầu kém đến nỗi không nhìn thấy được, đang nằm ở chỗ quen thuộc của mình,
vi.R: Một đêm kia, Hê-li đang nằm ở chỗ quen thuộc của ông. Mắt ông đã yếu dần, và ông không còn nhìn thấy được.

decisions.choice: his eyes: the reading the Hebrew text marks to be read
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the Hebrew text spell "his eye", singular. The scribes' note in the margin says to read "his eyes", which agrees with the plural verb "they began". The pinned data follows the marked reading. The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: it happened on that day: the opening of one long sentence
decisions.reason: "On that day" means "at that time", and introduces the night of Yahweh's call. The sentence that begins here describes Eli (verse 2), the lamp and Samuel (verse 3), and reaches its main event only in verse 4: "Yahweh called Samuel".

decisions.choice: his eyes had begun to grow dim: Eli was old and nearly blind
decisions.reason: Eli was very old (2:22). By 4:15 his eyes "stood" and he could not see at all. His failing sight also explains why a boy would expect to be called to help him in the night (verse 5).

decisions.choice: his usual place; One night
decisions.reason: "His place" means where he usually slept, so Balanced and Readable say "usual place". Readable says "One night" because the lamp and the lying down in verses 2-3 show that the call came at night. Readable splits the long sentence; Literal and Balanced keep it running into verse 4.

source.text: וְנֵ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ טֶ֣רֶם יִכְבֶּ֔ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֖ל שֹׁכֵ֑ב בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: and [the] lamp of God not yet had gone out, and Samuel [was] lying in [the] temple of Yahweh, where there [was the] ark of God,

en.L: and the lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, where the ark of God [was],
en.B: and the lamp of God had not yet gone out. Samuel lay in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, where God's ark was,
en.R: The lamp in God's house was still burning. Samuel was lying down in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple. God's ark was kept there.

es.L: y la lámpara de Dios aún no se había apagado, y Samuel estaba acostado en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, donde [estaba] el arca de Dios,
es.B: y la lámpara de Dios todavía no se había apagado. Samuel dormía en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, donde estaba el arca de Dios,
es.R: La lámpara de la casa de Dios todavía estaba encendida. Samuel estaba acostado en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí se guardaba el arca de Dios.

fr.L: et la lampe de Dieu ne s’était pas encore éteinte, et Samuel était couché dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, où [était] l’arche de Dieu,
fr.B: et la lampe de Dieu ne s’était pas encore éteinte. Samuel était couché dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, là où se trouvait l’arche de Dieu,
fr.R: La lampe de la maison de Dieu brûlait encore. Samuel était couché dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. C’est là qu’on gardait l’arche de Dieu.

vi.L: và đèn của Đức Chúa Trời chưa tắt, và Sa-mu-ên đang nằm trong đền của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nơi có hòm của Đức Chúa Trời,
vi.B: và đèn của Đức Chúa Trời chưa tắt. Sa-mu-ên nằm trong đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nơi có hòm của Đức Chúa Trời,
vi.R: Ngọn đèn trong nhà Đức Chúa Trời vẫn còn cháy. Sa-mu-ên đang nằm trong đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hòm của Đức Chúa Trời được đặt ở đó.

decisions.choice: the lamp of God had not yet gone out: it was before dawn
decisions.reason: The lamp in the sanctuary was kept burning from evening until morning (Exodus 27:20-21; Leviticus 24:2-3). If it had not yet gone out, the night was not yet over. The words may also hint that, although Yahweh's word was rare (verse 1), his light in Israel had not gone out.

decisions.choice: the temple of Yahweh: the sanctuary at Shiloh
decisions.reason: The word means a large house or palace, and is used for Yahweh's sanctuary. This is not the later temple in Jerusalem but the house of Yahweh at Shiloh, a building with a doorpost and doors (1:9; 3:15).

decisions.choice: where the ark of God was: the sanctuary that held the ark
decisions.reason: The clause says that the ark was kept in this sanctuary. It does not say that Samuel slept beside the ark; the ark stood in the inner room, and Samuel lay somewhere within the sanctuary buildings.

decisions.choice: was still burning; was kept
decisions.reason: Readable says positively what "had not yet gone out" means and adds "kept" to make clear that the ark was stored there.

decisions.choice: "hòm của Đức Chúa Trời" for the ark
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: "hòm của Đức Chúa Trời", "hòm của CHÚA", "hòm giao ước" through both books.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: and called Yahweh to Samuel, and he said, Here I [am].

en.L: that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called to Samuel, and he said, "Here I am."
en.B: and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel. He answered, "Here I am."
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel. Samuel answered, "Here I am!"

es.L: que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó a Samuel, y él dijo: «Aquí estoy».
es.B: y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó a Samuel. Él respondió: «Aquí estoy».
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó a Samuel. Samuel respondió: «¡Aquí estoy!».

fr.L: [qu’]{{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appela Samuel, et il dit : « Me voici. »
fr.B: et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appela Samuel. Il répondit : « Me voici. »
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé Samuel. Samuel a répondu : « Me voici ! »

vi.L: thì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gọi Sa-mu-ên, và cậu thưa: "Con đây."
vi.B: thì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gọi Sa-mu-ên. Cậu thưa: "Dạ, con đây."
vi.R: Bỗng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gọi Sa-mu-ên. Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Dạ, con đây!"

decisions.choice: Here I am: ready to listen and serve
decisions.reason: The reply means more than "I am in this place". It is how a servant or a son answers when called, ready to do what is asked (Genesis 22:1, 11; Exodus 3:4; Isaiah 6:8).

decisions.choice: called: the main event of the sentence begun in verse 2
decisions.reason: Verses 2 and 3 set the scene; this verb is the action they lead up to.

decisions.choice: Samuel answered
decisions.reason: Readable names Samuel as the speaker, since its sentences are short and "he" could be unclear.

decisions.choice: "Con đây" ("Dạ, con đây" at B and R) for "Here I am"
decisions.reason: Samuel thinks Eli has called him, and a boy answers his elder as "con"; the same words then serve for his answer to God.

source.text: וַיָּ֣רָץ אֶל־עֵלִ֗י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הִנְנִי֙ כִּֽי־קָרָ֣אתָ לִּ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לֹֽא־קָרָ֖אתִי שׁ֣וּב שְׁכָ֑ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁכָּֽב׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he ran to Eli and said, Here I [am], for you called to me. And he said, Not I called; return, lie down. And he went and lay down.

en.L: And he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call; go back, lie down." And he went and lay down.
en.B: He ran to Eli and said, "Here I am. You called me." But Eli said, "I did not call you. Go back and lie down." So he went and lay down.
en.R: He ran to Eli and said, "Here I am. You called me." "I did not call you," Eli said. "Go back to bed." So Samuel went back and lay down.

es.L: Y corrió a Elí y dijo: «Aquí estoy, porque me llamaste». Y él dijo: «Yo no llamé; vuelve, acuéstate». Y fue y se acostó.
es.B: Corrió hacia Elí y le dijo: «Aquí estoy. Tú me llamaste». Pero Elí le dijo: «Yo no te llamé. Vuelve a acostarte». Así que él fue y se acostó.
es.R: Corrió hacia Elí y le dijo: «Aquí estoy. Tú me llamaste». «Yo no te llamé», dijo Elí. «Vuelve a la cama». Entonces Samuel volvió y se acostó.

fr.L: Et il courut vers Éli et dit : « Me voici, car tu m’as appelé. » Et il dit : « Je n’ai pas appelé ; retourne, couche-toi. » Et il s’en alla et se coucha.
fr.B: Il courut vers Éli et lui dit : « Me voici, tu m’as appelé. » Mais Éli répondit : « Je ne t’ai pas appelé. Retourne te coucher. » Il s’en alla donc et se coucha.
fr.R: Il a couru vers Éli et lui a dit : « Me voici, tu m’as appelé. » « Je ne t’ai pas appelé, a dit Éli. Retourne te coucher. » Alors Samuel est retourné se coucher.

vi.L: Cậu chạy đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Con đây, vì thầy đã gọi con." Ông nói: "Ta không gọi; hãy trở về, nằm xuống đi." Cậu đi và nằm xuống.
vi.B: Cậu chạy đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Dạ, con đây. Thầy gọi con." Nhưng Hê-li bảo: "Ta không gọi con. Về nằm đi." Vậy cậu đi nằm.
vi.R: Cậu chạy đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Dạ, con đây. Thầy gọi con." Hê-li nói: "Ta không gọi con. Về ngủ đi." Vậy Sa-mu-ên trở về nằm.

decisions.choice: for you called me: Samuel gives the reason he has come
decisions.reason: The word "for" explains his coming. Samuel takes the voice to be Eli's, the only other person near him, and an old man who could not see might well need help at night.

decisions.choice: I did not call: Eli denies calling
decisions.reason: Eli says only that he did not call. Neither he nor Samuel yet thinks of Yahweh (verse 7).

decisions.choice: Eli said; Go back to bed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Eli as the speaker. Readable puts "go back, lie down" in everyday words.

decisions.choice: Samuel calls Eli "thầy" and himself "con"; Eli says "ta" and "con"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Eli is the boy's master and teacher at the sanctuary, and calls him "my son" (verse 6).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֗ה קְרֹ֣א עוֹד֮ שְׁמוּאֵל֒ וַיָּ֤קָם שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר לֹֽא־קָרָ֥אתִי בְנִ֖י שׁ֥וּב שְׁכָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And again Yahweh called yet Samuel, and rose Samuel and went to Eli and said, Here I [am], for you called to me. And he said, Not I called, my son; return, lie down.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel yet again, and Samuel rose and went to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." And he said, "I did not call, my son; go back, lie down."
en.B: Again {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel. Samuel got up, went to Eli, and said, "Here I am. You called me." "I did not call, my son," Eli replied. "Go back and lie down."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel again. Samuel got up and went to Eli. "Here I am," he said. "You called me." Eli answered, "I did not call you, my son. Go back to bed."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volvió a llamar otra vez a Samuel, y Samuel se levantó y fue a Elí y dijo: «Aquí estoy, porque me llamaste». Y él dijo: «Yo no llamé, hijo mío; vuelve, acuéstate».
es.B: Otra vez {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó a Samuel. Samuel se levantó, fue a donde estaba Elí y le dijo: «Aquí estoy. Tú me llamaste». «Yo no llamé, hijo mío», respondió Elí. «Vuelve a acostarte».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volvió a llamar a Samuel. Samuel se levantó y fue a donde estaba Elí. «Aquí estoy», le dijo. «Tú me llamaste». Elí le respondió: «Yo no te llamé, hijo mío. Vuelve a la cama».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appela encore une fois Samuel, et Samuel se leva et alla vers Éli et dit : « Me voici, car tu m’as appelé. » Et il dit : « Je n’ai pas appelé, mon fils ; retourne, couche-toi. »
fr.B: De nouveau {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appela Samuel. Samuel se leva, alla vers Éli et dit : « Me voici, tu m’as appelé. » « Je n’ai pas appelé, mon fils, répondit Éli. Retourne te coucher. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé Samuel encore une fois. Samuel s’est levé et il est allé vers Éli. « Me voici, a-t-il dit. Tu m’as appelé. » Éli a répondu : « Je ne t’ai pas appelé, mon fils. Retourne te coucher. »

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại gọi Sa-mu-ên lần nữa, và Sa-mu-ên đứng dậy đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Con đây, vì thầy đã gọi con." Ông nói: "Ta không gọi, con ơi; hãy trở về, nằm xuống đi."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại gọi Sa-mu-ên. Sa-mu-ên đứng dậy, đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Dạ, con đây. Thầy gọi con." Hê-li đáp: "Ta không gọi, con ạ. Về nằm đi."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại gọi Sa-mu-ên. Sa-mu-ên đứng dậy đến với Hê-li. Cậu thưa: "Dạ, con đây. Thầy gọi con." Hê-li đáp: "Ta không gọi con đâu, con ạ. Về ngủ đi."

decisions.choice: called yet again: the second of three calls
decisions.reason: The verb means "added" or "did again". The story repeats the same steps three times (verses 4-5, 6, 8) before anyone understands who is calling.

decisions.choice: my son: a kind address to a boy in Eli's care
decisions.reason: Samuel is not Eli's son. An older man could call a younger one "my son" as a sign of fatherly care (verse 16; Joshua 7:19).

decisions.choice: Eli replied; Eli answered
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Eli as the speaker.

decisions.choice: "hijo mío"
decisions.reason: The vocative "my son" (m2) is "hijo mío" at every level, the natural Spanish form of affectionate address; "mi hijo" in address sounds regional.

source.text: וּשְׁמוּאֵ֕ל טֶ֖רֶם יָדַ֣ע אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה וְטֶ֛רֶם יִגָּלֶ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו דְּבַר־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And Samuel not yet knew Yahweh, and not yet was revealed to him [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: And Samuel did not yet know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had not yet been revealed to him.
en.B: Samuel did not yet know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: no word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had yet been revealed to him.
en.R: Samuel did not yet know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in this way. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had never yet given him a message.

es.L: Y Samuel todavía no conocía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} aún no le había sido revelada.
es.B: Samuel todavía no conocía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: aún no se le había revelado ninguna palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Samuel todavía no conocía {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de esta manera. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nunca le había dado un mensaje.

fr.L: Or Samuel ne connaissait pas encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne lui avait pas encore été révélée.
fr.B: Samuel ne connaissait pas encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : aucune parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne lui avait encore été révélée.
fr.R: Samuel ne connaissait pas encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de cette façon. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne lui avait encore jamais donné de message.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên chưa biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chưa được tỏ ra cho cậu.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên chưa biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: chưa có lời nào của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được tỏ ra cho cậu.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên chưa biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} theo cách này. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chưa bao giờ ban sứ điệp cho cậu.

decisions.choice: did not yet know Yahweh: had not yet met him through his word
decisions.reason: The second half of the verse explains the first: Yahweh had not yet spoken to Samuel. It is not a charge of unbelief. Eli's sons "did not know Yahweh" (2:12) in a different sense: they refused to honor him. "Not yet" says that Samuel's knowing is about to begin.

decisions.choice: a comment by the narrator
decisions.reason: The verse pauses the story to explain why Samuel kept running to Eli: he did not recognize the voice.

decisions.choice: in this way; had never yet given him a message
decisions.reason: Readable adds "in this way" so that young readers do not take the sentence to mean that Samuel did not believe in Yahweh, and puts "the word was revealed to him" in plain words.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨סֶף יְהוָ֥ה קְרֹא־שְׁמוּאֵל֮ בַּשְּׁלִשִׁית֒ וַיָּ֨קָם֙ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־עֵלִ֔י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנְנִ֔י כִּ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ לִ֑י וַיָּ֣בֶן עֵלִ֔י כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קֹרֵ֥א לַנָּֽעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: And again Yahweh called Samuel the third [time], and he rose and went to Eli and said, Here I [am], for you called to me. And understood Eli that Yahweh [was] calling the boy.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel again, the third time, and he rose and went to Eli and said, "Here I am, for you called me." And Eli understood that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was calling the boy.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel a third time. He got up, went to Eli, and said, "Here I am. You called me." Then Eli realized that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was calling the boy.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} called Samuel a third time. Again Samuel got up and went to Eli. "Here I am," he said. "You called me." Then Eli understood that it was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who was calling the boy.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volvió a llamar a Samuel, por tercera vez, y él se levantó y fue a Elí y dijo: «Aquí estoy, porque me llamaste». Y Elí entendió que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamaba al muchacho.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó a Samuel por tercera vez. Él se levantó, fue a donde estaba Elí y le dijo: «Aquí estoy. Tú me llamaste». Entonces Elí se dio cuenta de que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba llamando al muchacho.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} llamó a Samuel por tercera vez. Otra vez Samuel se levantó y fue a donde estaba Elí. «Aquí estoy», le dijo. «Tú me llamaste». Entonces Elí comprendió que era {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien llamaba al muchacho.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appela encore Samuel, pour la troisième fois, et il se leva et alla vers Éli et dit : « Me voici, car tu m’as appelé. » Et Éli comprit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appelait l’enfant.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} appela Samuel une troisième fois. Il se leva, alla vers Éli et dit : « Me voici, tu m’as appelé. » Alors Éli comprit que c’était {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui appelait l’enfant.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a appelé Samuel une troisième fois. Samuel s’est encore levé et il est allé vers Éli. « Me voici, a-t-il dit. Tu m’as appelé. » Alors Éli a compris que c’était {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui appelait l’enfant.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại gọi Sa-mu-ên lần thứ ba, và cậu đứng dậy đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Con đây, vì thầy đã gọi con." Bấy giờ Hê-li hiểu rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang gọi cậu bé.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gọi Sa-mu-ên lần thứ ba. Cậu đứng dậy, đến với Hê-li và thưa: "Dạ, con đây. Thầy gọi con." Bấy giờ Hê-li nhận ra rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang gọi cậu bé.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} gọi Sa-mu-ên lần thứ ba. Sa-mu-ên lại đứng dậy đến với Hê-li. Cậu thưa: "Dạ, con đây. Thầy gọi con." Bấy giờ Hê-li hiểu rằng chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang gọi cậu bé.

decisions.choice: the third time: the call is completed
decisions.reason: The third call brings the pattern to its turning point. Now Eli understands.

decisions.choice: understood: came to see what was happening
decisions.reason: The verb means to discern or grasp. Eli's eyes were failing (verse 2), but he still recognized how Yahweh speaks, even though the word had become rare (verse 1).

decisions.choice: it was the LORD who was calling
decisions.reason: Readable stresses who was calling, because that is what Eli suddenly understood.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵלִ֣י לִשְׁמוּאֵל֮ לֵ֣ךְ שְׁכָב֒ וְהָיָה֙ אִם־יִקְרָ֣א אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ דַּבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Eli to Samuel, Go, lie down; and it will be, if he calls to you, then you will say, Speak, Yahweh, for listening [is] your servant. And went Samuel and lay down in his place.

en.L: And Eli said to Samuel, "Go, lie down, and it shall be, if {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} calls you, you shall say, 'Speak, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is listening.'" And Samuel went and lay down in his place.
en.B: So Eli told Samuel, "Go and lie down. If {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} calls you, then say, 'Speak, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is listening.'" So Samuel went back and lay down in his place.
en.R: So Eli said to Samuel, "Go and lie down. If {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} calls you again, say, 'Speak, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is listening.'" So Samuel went back and lay down in his place.

es.L: Y Elí dijo a Samuel: «Ve, acuéstate, y será que, si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te llama, dirás: “Habla, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo escucha”». Y Samuel fue y se acostó en su lugar.
es.B: Entonces Elí le dijo a Samuel: «Ve y acuéstate. Si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te llama, di: “Habla, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo escucha”». Así que Samuel volvió y se acostó en su lugar.
es.R: Entonces Elí le dijo a Samuel: «Ve y acuéstate. Si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te vuelve a llamar, dile: “Habla, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} está escuchando”». Así que Samuel volvió y se acostó en su lugar.

fr.L: Et Éli dit à Samuel : « Va, couche-toi ; et il arrivera, s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’appelle, que tu diras : “Parle, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur écoute.” » Et Samuel s’en alla et se coucha à sa place.
fr.B: Éli dit donc à Samuel : « Va te coucher. Et s’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’appelle, réponds : “Parle, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur écoute.” » Samuel retourna donc se coucher à sa place.
fr.R: Alors Éli a dit à Samuel : « Va te coucher. S’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’appelle encore, réponds : “Parle, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur écoute.” » Samuel est donc retourné se coucher à sa place.

vi.L: Hê-li nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy đi nằm; và nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi con, con hãy thưa: 'Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin phán, vì đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang nghe.'" Vậy Sa-mu-ên đi và nằm ở chỗ mình.
vi.B: Vậy Hê-li bảo Sa-mu-ên: "Con đi nằm đi. Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi con, thì con hãy thưa: 'Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin phán, vì đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang lắng nghe.'" Vậy Sa-mu-ên trở về nằm ở chỗ mình.
vi.R: Vậy Hê-li nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Con đi nằm đi. Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi con nữa, con hãy thưa: 'Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin phán, vì đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang lắng nghe.'" Vậy Sa-mu-ên trở về nằm ở chỗ mình.

decisions.choice: your servant: a humble way of speaking of oneself
decisions.reason: The word names a slave or servant, someone who belongs to a master and does his bidding. People used it of themselves when speaking to a superior, to offer their service. Samuel is to present himself to Yahweh as one ready to obey.

decisions.choice: listening: hearing with the readiness to obey
decisions.reason: The verb "hear" often includes doing what is heard (Deuteronomy 6:4). The form describes Samuel as listening now, ready for whatever Yahweh says.

decisions.choice: if he calls you: the caller is Yahweh
decisions.reason: Eli does not name the caller in this clause, but the reply he teaches, "Speak, Yahweh", shows whom he means.

decisions.choice: your servant (every level)
decisions.reason: Elsewhere Literal keeps "slave" for this word, but here it is a humble way of speaking of oneself, not a statement about slavery, so every level has "your servant", the courtesy form set for these books (also verse 10).

decisions.choice: calls you again
decisions.reason: Readable adds "again" because the call has come three times already.

decisions.choice: "ton serviteur" at every level
decisions.reason: Samuel speaks of himself in humility to God; as the Psalms note settles for "your servant" in speech to God, French says "serviteur" at every level, Literal included.

decisions.choice: "tu siervo" at every level
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel and Psalms notes: the humble self-designation "your servant", in speech to God or to the king, is "tu siervo" at every level, as the English here (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ngài" at every level for "your servant" spoken to God
decisions.reason: As the English, every level keeps the humble self-description here (meaning decision); elsewhere in prayer Samuel says "con".

records.literal_gloss: And came Yahweh and stood and called as time at time, Samuel, Samuel. And said Samuel, Speak, for listening [is] your servant.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came and stood and called as at the other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" And Samuel said, "Speak, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is listening."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} came and took {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} stand there, and called as before, "Samuel! Samuel!" Samuel replied, "Speak, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is listening."
en.R: Then {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came and stood there. He called as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had before, "Samuel! Samuel!" Samuel answered, "Speak, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant is listening."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino y se puso en pie y llamó como las otras veces: «¡Samuel! ¡Samuel!». Y Samuel dijo: «Habla, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo escucha».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino, se presentó allí y llamó como antes: «¡Samuel! ¡Samuel!». Samuel respondió: «Habla, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo escucha».
es.R: Entonces {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vino y se quedó allí de pie. Llamó como lo había hecho antes: «¡Samuel! ¡Samuel!». Samuel respondió: «Habla, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} está escuchando».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vint et se tint là, et appela comme les autres fois : « Samuel ! Samuel ! » Et Samuel dit : « Parle, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur écoute. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vint, se tint là et appela comme auparavant : « Samuel ! Samuel ! » Samuel répondit : « Parle, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur écoute. »
fr.R: Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est venu et il s’est tenu là. Il a appelé comme les autres fois : « Samuel ! Samuel ! » Samuel a répondu : « Parle, car {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur écoute. »

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến, đứng đó, và gọi như những lần trước: "Sa-mu-ên! Sa-mu-ên!" Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Xin phán, vì đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang nghe."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến, đứng tại đó và gọi như những lần trước: "Sa-mu-ên! Sa-mu-ên!" Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Xin phán, vì đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang lắng nghe."
vi.R: Rồi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến và đứng đó. Ngài gọi như những lần trước: "Sa-mu-ên! Sa-mu-ên!" Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Xin phán, vì đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang lắng nghe."

decisions.choice: came and stood: Yahweh was present, not only a voice
decisions.reason: The verbs describe a visit: Yahweh came and took his place there. Verse 15 calls what Samuel received a "vision". The text does not describe what Samuel saw.

decisions.choice: as time at time: as on the earlier occasions
decisions.reason: The phrase means "as before" (Numbers 24:1; Judges 16:20). The call came in the same way as the three before it.

decisions.choice: Samuel! Samuel!: the name said twice
decisions.reason: Calling a name twice marks a call that is urgent and personal (Genesis 22:11; 46:2; Exodus 3:4).

decisions.choice: Speak: Samuel answers without the name
decisions.reason: Eli told Samuel to say "Speak, Yahweh" (verse 9). Samuel says "Speak" without the divine name. The text does not explain why.

decisions.choice: took his stand there
decisions.reason: The verb form means to station oneself, to take a position. Balanced keeps that sense; Literal and Readable say "stood".

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הִנֵּ֧ה אָנֹכִ֛י עֹשֶׂ֥ה דָבָ֖ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל־שֹׁ֣מְע֔וֹ תְּצִלֶּ֖ינָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Samuel, Behold, I [am] doing a thing in Israel which every [one] hearing it, will tingle both his ears.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Look, I am doing a thing in Israel at which both ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Look, I am about to do something in Israel that will make both ears of all who hear of it tingle.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Listen! I am about to do something in Israel that is so shocking that it will make the ears of everyone who hears about it ring.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Samuel: «Mira, yo hago una cosa en Israel que a todo el que la oiga le zumbarán ambos oídos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Mira, estoy a punto de hacer algo en Israel que hará zumbar los oídos de todos los que lo oigan.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «¡Escucha! Voy a hacer algo en Israel tan terrible que a todos los que lo oigan les zumbarán los oídos.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Voici, je fais en Israël une chose telle que les deux oreilles de quiconque l’entendra tinteront.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Voici, je vais faire en Israël une chose qui fera tinter les deux oreilles de tous ceux qui en entendront parler.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Écoute ! Je vais faire en Israël quelque chose de si terrible que tous ceux qui l’apprendront en auront les oreilles qui bourdonnent.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang làm một việc trong Y-sơ-ra-ên mà hễ ai nghe đến, cả hai tai đều sẽ lùng bùng.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm một việc trong Y-sơ-ra-ên khiến ai nghe đến cũng phải ù cả hai tai.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy nghe đây! Ta sắp làm một việc trong Y-sơ-ra-ên khủng khiếp đến nỗi ai nghe đến cũng phải ù tai.

decisions.choice: both ears will tingle: news so dreadful that it stuns the hearer
decisions.reason: The same picture is used of terrible judgments in 2 Kings 21:12 and Jeremiah 19:3. What Yahweh is about to do will shock everyone who hears of it; 4:10-22 tells what it was.

decisions.choice: I am doing: an action about to happen
decisions.reason: The participle after "look" describes something already set in motion and about to take place.

decisions.choice: a thing: an event, a deed
decisions.reason: The word can mean "word" or "thing". Here it is something Yahweh does, an event in Israel.

decisions.choice: about to do; so shocking; ring
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the sense of "look, I am doing" with "about to". Readable says what the tingling ears mean and uses "ring", a picture young readers know.

source.text: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ אָקִ֣ים אֶל־עֵלִ֔י אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־בֵּית֑וֹ הָחֵ֖ל וְכַלֵּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: On the day the that I will carry out against Eli all that I have spoken against his house, beginning and finishing.

en.L: On that day I will carry out against Eli all that I have spoken concerning his house, beginning and finishing.
en.B: On that day I will carry out against Eli all I have said about his family, from beginning to end.
en.R: When that day comes, I will do to Eli and his family everything I said I would do, all of it, from start to finish.

es.L: En aquel día cumpliré contra Elí todo lo que he hablado acerca de su casa, comenzando y acabando.
es.B: Ese día cumpliré contra Elí todo lo que he dicho acerca de su familia, de principio a fin.
es.R: Cuando llegue ese día, haré con Elí y su familia todo lo que dije que haría, todo, de principio a fin.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, j’accomplirai contre Éli tout ce que j’ai dit contre sa maison, en commençant et en achevant.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, j’accomplirai contre Éli tout ce que j’ai dit au sujet de sa famille, du début jusqu’à la fin.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, je ferai à Éli et à sa famille tout ce que j’ai dit, absolument tout, du début à la fin.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thực hiện nghịch cùng Hê-li mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán về nhà người, từ đầu đến cuối.
vi.B: Trong ngày ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thực hiện nghịch cùng Hê-li mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán về gia đình người, từ đầu đến cuối.
vi.R: Khi ngày ấy đến, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho Hê-li và gia đình người mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán, không sót điều gì, từ đầu đến cuối.

decisions.choice: all that I have spoken: the message of the man of God
decisions.reason: Yahweh has already announced the judgment on Eli's house through an unnamed man of God (2:27-36): the priesthood will pass from his family, and his two sons will die on one day (2:34). What Samuel hears confirms that word.

decisions.choice: his house: his family line
decisions.reason: "House" means Eli's household and descendants, the priestly family that was to serve Yahweh (2:30-31).

decisions.choice: beginning and finishing: completely
decisions.reason: Two verb forms side by side say that Yahweh will begin and bring to an end everything he said, leaving nothing undone.

decisions.choice: family; from beginning to end; from start to finish
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "family" for "house", and turn the two verbs into an everyday phrase for completeness.

source.text: וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־שֹׁפֵ֥ט אֲנִ֛י אֶת־בֵּית֖וֹ עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם בַּעֲוֺ֣ן אֲשֶׁר־יָדַ֗ע כִּֽי־מְקַֽלְלִ֤ים לָהֶם֙ בָּנָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א כִהָ֖ה בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I have told to him that judging I [am] his house until forever for [the] iniquity which he knew, for bringing a curse on themselves [were] his sons, and not he restrained them.

en.L: And I have told him that I am about to judge his house forever for the iniquity that he knew, because his sons were bringing a curse on themselves, and he did not restrain them.
en.B: I told him that I would bring judgment on his family forever, because of the guilt he knew about: his sons were bringing a curse on themselves, and he did not restrain them.
en.R: I told Eli that I would punish his family forever because of the wrong he knew about. His sons were bringing a curse on themselves, and he did not stop them.

es.L: Y le he dicho que voy a juzgar su casa para siempre por la iniquidad que él conocía, porque sus hijos atraían sobre sí una maldición, y él no los reprimió.
es.B: Le dije que juzgaría a su familia para siempre por la culpa que él conocía: sus hijos atraían sobre sí una maldición, y él no los frenó.
es.R: Le dije a Elí que castigaría a su familia para siempre por el mal que él conocía. Sus hijos atraían una maldición sobre sí mismos, y él no los detuvo.

fr.L: Et je lui ai annoncé que je vais juger sa maison pour toujours, à cause de la faute qu’il connaissait, parce que ses fils attiraient sur eux la malédiction, et il ne les a pas retenus.
fr.B: Je lui ai annoncé que j’allais juger sa famille pour toujours, à cause de la faute dont il avait connaissance : ses fils attiraient sur eux la malédiction, et il ne les a pas retenus.
fr.R: J’ai dit à Éli que je punirais sa famille pour toujours, à cause du mal qu’il connaissait. Ses fils attiraient sur eux la malédiction, et il ne les a pas arrêtés.

vi.L: Ta đã bảo người rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xét xử nhà người mãi mãi vì tội ác mà người đã biết, vì các con trai người tự chuốc lấy sự rủa sả, mà người không ngăn cấm chúng.
vi.B: Ta đã bảo người rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đoán phạt gia đình người mãi mãi vì tội mà người đã biết: các con trai người tự chuốc lấy sự rủa sả, mà người không ngăn cấm.
vi.R: Ta đã bảo Hê-li rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt gia đình người mãi mãi vì điều sai trái mà người đã biết. Các con trai người tự chuốc lấy sự rủa sả, mà người không ngăn cản chúng.

decisions.choice: bringing a curse on themselves: the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "cursing (or: treating with contempt) for themselves", which is an awkward phrase. The ancient Greek translation reads "speaking evil of God" here, which would mean that its Hebrew had the word for "God" where ours has "to themselves"; the two words share several letters. Jewish scribal tradition lists this verse among a small number of places where the scribes are said to have changed a phrase so that it did not speak of cursing God outright. So the original may have said that Eli's sons were cursing God, or treating him with contempt, which fits their contempt for his offerings (2:17, 29). This translation follows the Hebrew text as it stands. This note is drawn from general knowledge of the manuscripts and the scribal lists, and must be checked against a critical apparatus.

decisions.choice: I have told him: Yahweh has already told Eli
decisions.reason: The verb form usually looks ahead ("and I will tell him", or "and you shall tell him"). Here it most likely points back to the message of the man of God (2:27-36), which Samuel's vision now confirms. But it may also announce that Yahweh is now telling Eli, through Samuel.

decisions.choice: did not restrain them: did not stop them
decisions.reason: The verb means to rebuke or hold back. Eli spoke to his sons (2:23-25) but did not stop them, and so honored them more than Yahweh (2:29). The verb comes from the same root as the word for Eli's eyes growing dim (verse 2).

decisions.choice: judging his house for the iniquity: punishing the family for its guilt
decisions.reason: "Judge" here means to pass sentence and carry it out. "Iniquity" is both the wrong done and the guilt it brings. Eli knew what his sons were doing (2:22-24); that knowledge, without action, is his guilt.

decisions.choice: guilt; the wrong they were doing; stop them
decisions.reason: Balanced says "guilt" for the word Literal renders "iniquity". Readable breaks the sentence into short ones and uses everyday words.

source.text: וְלָכֵ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לְבֵ֣ית עֵלִ֑י אִֽם־יִתְכַּפֵּ֞ר עֲוֺ֧ן בֵּית־עֵלִ֛י בְּזֶ֥בַח וּבְמִנְחָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And therefore I have sworn to [the] house of Eli, if will be atoned [the] iniquity of [the] house of Eli by sacrifice and by offering until forever.

en.L: And therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli that the iniquity of the house of Eli will surely not be atoned for by sacrifice or by offering, forever."
en.B: Therefore I have sworn to Eli's family that no sacrifice or offering will ever make atonement for the guilt of Eli's family."
en.R: So I have made a solemn promise to Eli's family: no sacrifice or offering will ever make atonement for their sin."

es.L: Y por eso he jurado a la casa de Elí que la iniquidad de la casa de Elí no será expiada jamás con sacrificio ni con ofrenda».
es.B: Por eso he jurado a la familia de Elí que ningún sacrificio ni ofrenda hará jamás expiación por la culpa de la familia de Elí».
es.R: Por eso le he hecho una promesa solemne a la familia de Elí: ningún sacrificio ni ofrenda podrá nunca hacer expiación por su pecado».

fr.L: Et c’est pourquoi j’ai juré à la maison d’Éli que la faute de la maison d’Éli ne sera jamais expiée, ni par sacrifice ni par offrande, pour toujours. »
fr.B: C’est pourquoi j’ai juré à la famille d’Éli qu’aucun sacrifice ni aucune offrande n’expieront jamais la faute de la famille d’Éli. »
fr.R: Alors j’ai fait une promesse solennelle à la famille d’Éli : aucun sacrifice ni aucune offrande ne pourra jamais effacer leur péché. »

vi.L: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề với nhà Hê-li rằng tội ác của nhà Hê-li sẽ không bao giờ được chuộc bởi sinh tế hay bởi lễ vật, mãi mãi."
vi.B: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề với gia đình Hê-li rằng không một sinh tế hay lễ vật nào có thể chuộc tội cho gia đình Hê-li được."
vi.R: Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã long trọng thề với gia đình Hê-li: không một sinh tế hay lễ vật nào có thể chuộc tội cho họ được."

decisions.choice: if it will be atoned for: a strong "never" in an oath
decisions.reason: In an oath, "if" with nothing following it is a way of saying "surely not": the speaker leaves unsaid what should happen if the thing comes about. Yahweh swears that the guilt will never be atoned for.

decisions.choice: no sacrifice or offering: the sin was against the offerings themselves
decisions.reason: Eli's sons treated Yahweh's offerings with contempt (2:12-17, 29). The means of atonement were the very thing they despised, so they cannot cover this guilt. Eli had already warned them that no one could plead for a man who sins against Yahweh (2:25).

decisions.choice: offering: an offering of any kind
decisions.reason: The word often names the grain offering, but paired with "sacrifice" it stands for offerings in general, as in 2:17 and 2:29. Together the two words mean the whole system of offerings.

decisions.choice: guilt; sin; offering
decisions.reason: Balanced says "guilt" and Readable "sin" for the word Literal renders "iniquity". "Offering" is used rather than "grain offering" for the reason given above.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁמוּאֵל֙ עַד־הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיִּפְתַּ֖ח אֶת־דַּלְת֣וֹת בֵּית־יְהוָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּאֵ֣ל יָרֵ֔א מֵהַגִּ֥יד אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֖ה אֶל־עֵלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And lay Samuel until the morning, and he opened [the] doors of [the] house of Yahweh; and Samuel [was] afraid of telling the vision to Eli.

en.L: And Samuel lay until the morning, and he opened the doors of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And Samuel was afraid to tell the vision to Eli.
en.B: Samuel lay there until morning, and then he opened the doors of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house. But he was afraid to tell Eli about the vision.
en.R: Samuel lay in bed until morning. Then he opened the doors of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house. But he was afraid to tell Eli about the vision {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had given him.

es.L: Y Samuel estuvo acostado hasta la mañana, y abrió las puertas de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y Samuel tenía miedo de contar la visión a Elí.
es.B: Samuel se quedó acostado hasta la mañana, y luego abrió las puertas de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Pero tenía miedo de contarle a Elí la visión.
es.R: Samuel se quedó en la cama hasta la mañana. Luego abrió las puertas de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Pero tenía miedo de contarle a Elí la visión que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dado.

fr.L: Et Samuel resta couché jusqu’au matin, et il ouvrit les portes de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Et Samuel avait peur de raconter la vision à Éli.
fr.B: Samuel resta couché jusqu’au matin, puis il ouvrit les portes de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Mais il craignait de raconter la vision à Éli.
fr.R: Samuel est resté couché jusqu’au matin. Puis il a ouvert les portes de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Mais il avait peur de raconter à Éli la vision que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait donnée.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nằm cho đến sáng, rồi mở các cửa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Sa-mu-ên sợ kể khải tượng ấy cho Hê-li.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nằm đó cho đến sáng, rồi mở các cửa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nhưng cậu sợ không dám kể khải tượng cho Hê-li.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nằm trên giường cho đến sáng. Rồi cậu mở các cửa nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nhưng cậu sợ không dám kể cho Hê-li nghe về khải tượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho mình.

decisions.choice: opened the doors: Samuel's morning duty
decisions.reason: The sanctuary at Shiloh was a building with doors (1:9). Opening them in the morning was part of the work of those who served there. Samuel goes about his duty as usual.

decisions.choice: the vision: the whole encounter of the night
decisions.reason: The word means something seen. It covers Yahweh's coming and standing (verse 10) as well as his words. It answers verse 1, where there was "no vision".

decisions.choice: afraid to tell: Samuel's fear
decisions.reason: The message was against Eli, the man who had raised him. The text says only that Samuel was afraid; verses 16-17 show that Eli had to press him.

decisions.choice: the vision the LORD had given him
decisions.reason: Readable says who gave the vision.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א עֵלִי֙ אֶת־שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל בְּנִ֑י וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Eli Samuel and said, Samuel, my son. And he said, Here I [am].

en.L: And Eli called Samuel and said, "Samuel, my son!" And he said, "Here I am."
en.B: But Eli called Samuel. "Samuel, my son!" he said. And Samuel answered, "Here I am."
en.R: But Eli called out to him, "Samuel, my son!" Samuel answered, "Here I am."

es.L: Y Elí llamó a Samuel y dijo: «¡Samuel, hijo mío!». Y él dijo: «Aquí estoy».
es.B: Pero Elí llamó a Samuel. «¡Samuel, hijo mío!», le dijo. Y Samuel respondió: «Aquí estoy».
es.R: Pero Elí lo llamó: «¡Samuel, hijo mío!». Samuel respondió: «Aquí estoy».

fr.L: Et Éli appela Samuel et dit : « Samuel, mon fils ! » Et il dit : « Me voici. »
fr.B: Mais Éli appela Samuel : « Samuel, mon fils ! » dit-il. Et Samuel répondit : « Me voici. »
fr.R: Mais Éli l’a appelé : « Samuel, mon fils ! » Samuel a répondu : « Me voici. »

vi.L: Hê-li gọi Sa-mu-ên và nói: "Sa-mu-ên, con ơi!" Cậu thưa: "Con đây."
vi.B: Nhưng Hê-li gọi Sa-mu-ên: "Sa-mu-ên, con ơi!" Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Dạ, con đây."
vi.R: Nhưng Hê-li gọi cậu: "Sa-mu-ên, con ơi!" Sa-mu-ên thưa: "Dạ, con đây."

decisions.choice: Here I am: the same answer as in the night
decisions.reason: Samuel answers Eli with the word he gave four times in the night (verses 4-6, 8). The one who taught him to answer Yahweh now calls for the message.

decisions.choice: my son: fatherly care
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, Eli speaks to Samuel kindly, as a father would.

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin with "But": Samuel was afraid to speak (verse 15), yet Eli called him.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָ֤ה הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔יךָ אַל־נָ֥א תְכַחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כֹּ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ֤ אֱלֹהִים֙ וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף אִם־תְּכַחֵ֤ד מִמֶּ֨נִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר מִכָּל־הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, What [is] the word which he spoke to you? Do not, please, hide from me. Thus may do to you God and thus may he add, if you hide from me a word from all the word which he spoke to you.

en.L: And he said, "What [is] the word that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to you? Please do not hide [it] from me. Thus may God do to you, and thus may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} add, if you hide from me a word of all the word that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to you."
en.B: Eli asked, "What was the message {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave you? Please do not hide it from me. May God deal with you ever so severely if you hide from me anything of all that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told you."
en.R: Eli asked, "What did {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} say to you? Please do not hide it from me. May God punish you terribly if you keep back from me anything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} told you!"

es.L: Y él dijo: «¿Cuál [es] la palabra que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te habló? Te ruego que no [me la] ocultes. Así te haga Dios, y así te añada, si me ocultas una palabra de todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te habló».
es.B: Elí le preguntó: «¿Qué mensaje te dio? Por favor, no me lo ocultes. Que Dios te castigue, y aun más, si me ocultas algo de todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te dijo».
es.R: Elí le preguntó: «¿Qué te dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}? Por favor, no me lo ocultes. ¡Que Dios te castigue duramente si me escondes algo de lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te dijo!».

fr.L: Et il dit : « Quelle [est] la parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a dite ? Ne me la cache pas, je te prie. Que Dieu te fasse ainsi, et qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} y ajoute encore, si tu me caches une seule parole de toute la parole qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a dite ! »
fr.B: Éli lui demanda : « Quel est le message qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a donné ? Ne me le cache pas, je t’en prie. Que Dieu te traite avec sévérité, et plus encore, si tu me caches quoi que ce soit de tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a dit ! »
fr.R: Éli lui a demandé : « Qu’est-ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a dit ? Je t’en prie, ne me cache rien. Que Dieu te punisse très durement si tu ne me dis pas tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a dit ! »

vi.L: Ông hỏi: "Lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với con [là] gì? Xin đừng giấu ta. Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời xử con như thế, và còn thêm nữa, nếu con giấu ta một lời nào trong mọi lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với con."
vi.B: Hê-li hỏi: "Ngài đã phán gì với con? Đừng giấu ta. Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt con thật nặng nề nếu con giấu ta bất cứ điều gì trong mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với con."
vi.R: Hê-li hỏi: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán gì với con? Đừng giấu ta. Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt con thật nặng nếu con giấu ta bất cứ điều gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với con!"

decisions.choice: thus may God do to you, and thus may he add: a solemn oath
decisions.reason: This is the form of a curse called down if a promise is broken (Ruth 1:17; 1 Samuel 14:44; 20:13). The speaker leaves unsaid what "thus" will be. Eli puts Samuel under this oath to make him tell everything.

decisions.choice: he spoke: the speaker is Yahweh
decisions.reason: Eli does not name the one who spoke, but he knows from the night (verse 8) that it was Yahweh.

decisions.choice: the word: the message
decisions.reason: The same word is used three times: "the word he spoke", "a word", "all the word". Eli wants the whole message, every part of it.

decisions.choice: ever so severely; the LORD; May God punish you severely
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the same form of the oath as Ruth 1:17. Readable names the LORD as the one who spoke, and says plainly what the oath means.

decisions.choice: "Que Dieu te fasse ainsi, et qu’il y ajoute encore" (Literal); "Que Dieu te traite avec sévérité, et plus encore" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The oath formula follows the Samuel terms note at Balanced, turned here to "you"; Literal keeps the Hebrew words, and Readable says plainly what the oath calls down (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Así te haga Dios, y así te añada" (L); "Que Dios te castigue, y aun más" (B); "Que Dios te castigue duramente" (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel: the self-curse of an oath (m1) keeps its Hebrew shape at Literal; Balanced takes the form of the Samuel terms note ("Que Dios me castigue, y aun más"), here turned on Samuel; Readable says it plainly, as the English Readable.

decisions.choice: "Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời xử con như thế, và còn thêm nữa" (L); "Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt con thật nặng nề" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath formula of the Samuel terms note ("Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời phạt tôi nặng nề"), here spoken over another person; Literal keeps the Hebrew's two verbs.

source.text: וַיַּגֶּד־ל֤וֹ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א כִחֵ֖ד מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖ויַעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And told to him Samuel all the words, and not he hid from him. And he said, Yahweh [is] he; the good in his eyes he will do.

en.L: And Samuel told him all the words and did not hide [anything] from him. And he said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} [is] he; let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} do what [is] good in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes."
en.B: So Samuel told him everything and hid nothing from him. Eli said, "He is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} do what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees is good."
en.R: So Samuel told him everything. He did not hide anything from Eli. Then Eli said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who decides. Let {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} do whatever {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thinks is best."

es.L: Y Samuel le contó todas las palabras y no le ocultó [nada]. Y él dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es] él; que haga lo que [es] bueno a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos».
es.B: Así que Samuel se lo contó todo, sin ocultarle nada. Elí dijo: «Él es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Que haga lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} parezca bien».
es.R: Entonces Samuel se lo contó todo. No le ocultó nada a Elí. Y Elí dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es quien decide. Que haga lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} crea mejor».

fr.L: Et Samuel lui raconta toutes les paroles et ne lui cacha rien. Et il dit : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse ce qui [est] bon à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux. »
fr.B: Samuel lui raconta donc tout, sans rien lui cacher. Éli dit : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse ce qui lui semble bon. »
fr.R: Alors Samuel lui a tout raconté. Il n’a rien caché à Éli. Éli a dit : « C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui décide. Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} juge bon. »

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên kể cho ông mọi lời và không giấu [điều gì]. Ông nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đấng ấy; nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều tốt trong mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Vậy Sa-mu-ên kể hết cho ông, không giấu điều gì. Hê-li nói: "Ngài là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy là tốt."
vi.R: Vậy Sa-mu-ên kể hết cho ông. Cậu không giấu Hê-li điều gì. Rồi Hê-li nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng quyết định. Xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm điều gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy là tốt nhất."

decisions.choice: He is Yahweh: a statement of who God is
decisions.reason: Eli does not argue or plead. He says that the one who has spoken is Yahweh, and that this settles the matter.

decisions.choice: let him do: a wish of acceptance
alternatives: he will do what is good in his eyes
decisions.reason: The verb form can state what will happen ("he will do") or express a wish ("let him do"). Coming from Eli after a word of judgment, it is best taken as accepting Yahweh's will.

decisions.choice: good in his eyes: what he judges right
decisions.reason: "In his eyes" means in his judgment. Eli leaves the outcome to Yahweh's judgment.

decisions.choice: He is the LORD; the one who decides; what he sees is good
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the short Hebrew sentence in natural order. Readable explains why naming the LORD settles the matter, and says "whatever he thinks is best" for "what is good in his eyes".

source.text: וַיִּגְדַּ֖ל שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַֽיהוָה֙ הָיָ֣ה עִמּ֔וֹ וְלֹֽא־הִפִּ֥יל מִכָּל־דְּבָרָ֖יו אָֽרְצָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And grew Samuel, and Yahweh was with him, and not he let fall from all his words to [the] ground.

en.L: And Samuel grew, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was with him and did not let any of all his words fall to the ground.
en.B: Samuel grew up, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was with him; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did not let any of his words fall to the ground.
en.R: Samuel grew up. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was with him and made everything Samuel said come true.

es.L: Y Samuel creció, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con él y no dejó caer a tierra ninguna de todas sus palabras.
es.B: Samuel crecía, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con él; no dejaba que ninguna de sus palabras cayera a tierra.
es.R: Samuel creció. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con él y hacía que se cumpliera todo lo que Samuel decía.

fr.L: Et Samuel grandit, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec lui et ne laissa tomber à terre aucune de toutes ses paroles.
fr.B: Samuel grandit, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec lui ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne laissa tomber à terre aucune de ses paroles.
fr.R: Samuel a grandi. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec lui et réalisait tout ce que Samuel annonçait.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên lớn lên, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng người và không để một lời nào trong mọi lời của người rơi xuống đất.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên lớn lên, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng người; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không để lời nào của người rơi xuống đất.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên lớn lên. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở cùng người và làm cho mọi điều Sa-mu-ên nói đều thành sự thật.

decisions.choice: fall to the ground: fail, come to nothing
decisions.reason: A word that falls to the ground is one that is never fulfilled (Joshua 21:45; 23:14; 2 Kings 10:10). Yahweh made sure that what Samuel spoke came true.

decisions.choice: his words: Samuel's words
decisions.reason: "His" most naturally refers to Samuel, whose words Yahweh fulfilled; this is the mark of a true prophet (Deuteronomy 18:21-22), and the next verse speaks of Samuel as a prophet. It could also refer to Yahweh's own words spoken through Samuel; in the end these are the same words.

decisions.choice: Yahweh was with him: Yahweh's help and favor
decisions.reason: The phrase is said of people whom God protects and makes successful (Genesis 39:2-3; 1 Samuel 18:12, 14).

decisions.choice: made everything Samuel said come true
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of words falling to the ground and names Samuel to make clear whose words are meant.

decisions.choice: the narrator now calls Samuel "người"
decisions.reason: From the end of chapter 3 Samuel is a grown man and a prophet; "người" is the respectful narrative pronoun the published Genesis uses for a revered figure.

source.text: וַיֵּ֨דַע֙ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִדָּ֖ן וְעַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כִּ֚י נֶאֱמָ֣ן שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל לְנָבִ֖יא לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And knew all Israel from Dan and to Beersheba that established [was] Samuel as prophet of Yahweh.

en.L: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: All Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, knew that Samuel was a proven prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: All the people of Israel, from Dan in the far north to Beersheba in the far south, knew that Samuel was a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who could be trusted.

es.L: Y todo Israel, desde Dan hasta Beerseba, supo que Samuel había sido confirmado como profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Todo Israel, desde Dan hasta Beerseba, supo que Samuel era un profeta acreditado {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Todo el pueblo de Israel, desde Dan en el extremo norte hasta Beerseba en el extremo sur, supo que Samuel era un profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} digno de confianza.

fr.L: Et tout Israël, depuis Dan jusqu’à Beer-Shéba, sut que Samuel était établi comme prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tout Israël, depuis Dan jusqu’à Beer-Shéba, reconnut que Samuel était un vrai prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Tout le peuple d’Israël, depuis Dan tout au nord jusqu’à Beer-Shéba tout au sud, a su que Samuel était un prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} en qui on pouvait avoir confiance.

vi.L: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên từ Đan đến Bê-e-Sê-ba đều biết rằng Sa-mu-ên đã được xác lập làm nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ Đan đến Bê-e-Sê-ba, đều biết Sa-mu-ên là nhà tiên tri đáng tin cậy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ Đan ở tận phía bắc đến Bê-e-Sê-ba ở tận phía nam, đều biết rằng Sa-mu-ên là nhà tiên tri của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là người có thể tin cậy được.

decisions.choice: from Dan to Beersheba: the whole land
decisions.reason: Dan was the northernmost town of Israel and Beersheba lay in the far south, so the phrase means the whole country (Judges 20:1; 2 Samuel 24:2).

decisions.choice: confirmed: shown to be reliable
decisions.reason: The verb means to be firm, proved true, trustworthy. The same word was used in 2:35 of the "faithful priest" and the "sure house" Yahweh would raise up in place of Eli's family.

decisions.choice: prophet: one who speaks for God
decisions.reason: This is the first time the book calls Samuel a prophet: one through whom Yahweh speaks to his people.

decisions.choice: a proven prophet; a prophet who could be trusted; in the far north, in the far south
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express "confirmed" as the result: Samuel was known to be reliable. Readable adds where Dan and Beersheba lay.

decisions.choice: "từ Đan đến Bê-e-Sê-ba"; "nhà tiên tri"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; "Bê-e-Sê-ba" is the form of the published Genesis.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥סֶף יְהוָ֖ה לְהֵרָאֹ֣ה בְשִׁלֹ֑ה כִּֽי־נִגְלָ֨ה יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל בְּשִׁל֖וֹ בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And again Yahweh to appear in Shiloh, for revealed himself Yahweh to Samuel in Shilo by [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} continued to appear at Shiloh, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} revealed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} to Samuel at Shiloh by the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} continued to appear at Shiloh, because there at Shiloh {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} revealed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} to Samuel through the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} kept on showing {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} at Shiloh. There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known to Samuel by speaking {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word to him.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volvió a aparecerse en Silo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se reveló a Samuel en Silo por la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} siguió apareciéndose en Silo, porque allí, en Silo, se revelaba a Samuel por medio de la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} siguió mostrándose en Silo. Allí se daba a conocer a Samuel hablándole {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} continua d’apparaître à Silo, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} révélait à Samuel à Silo par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} continua d’apparaître à Silo, car c’est là, à Silo, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} révélait à Samuel par la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a continué à {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} montrer à Silo. C’est là qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} faisait connaître à Samuel en lui donnant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tiếp tục hiện ra tại Si-lô, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tỏ mình cho Sa-mu-ên tại Si-lô bằng lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tiếp tục hiện ra tại Si-lô, vì tại Si-lô {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ mình cho Sa-mu-ên qua lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tiếp tục tỏ mình ra tại Si-lô. Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Sa-mu-ên biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng cách phán lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với người.

decisions.choice: continued to appear; revealed himself: the chapter comes full circle
decisions.reason: The chapter began with the word of Yahweh rare and no vision breaking out (verse 1), and with the word not yet revealed to Samuel (verse 7). It ends with Yahweh appearing again and again at Shiloh and revealing himself to Samuel.

decisions.choice: by the word of Yahweh: Yahweh made himself known through his word
decisions.reason: Yahweh's appearing took the form of his word spoken to Samuel. That word is what the verse means by his revealing himself.

decisions.choice: Shiloh: one town, spelled two ways
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells the name of the town in two slightly different ways in this verse. Both name the same place; the meaning is not affected.

decisions.choice: kept on showing himself; made himself known by speaking his word to him
decisions.reason: Readable uses everyday words for "continued to appear" and "revealed himself", and says "his word" for "the word of the LORD".
